title: 27th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/27/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of a member to the Human Rights Commission under Article 190(b) of the Constitution and Article 5 of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
First reading of the Re-employment Bill submitted on behalf of the government by Guraidhoo MP Hanaan Mohamed Rasheed.
Preliminary debate on the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent a Human Rights Commission nominee to committee, gave first readings to the Media and Broadcasting Regulation Bill and the Re-employment Bill, and opened debate on the media bill.
